title: Deductible Amount
plain_english_summary: You are being billed this amount because you have not reached your annual insurance deductible yet.
patient_action_tip: Log into your health insurance portal to confirm your deductible balance on the date of service.

title: Coinsurance Amount
plain_english_summary: Your insurance plan paid their contracted percentage (e.g., 80%), and this is your required patient share (e.g., 20%).
patient_action_tip: Verify that your plan's coinsurance percentage matches what is billed on your EOB.

title: Copayment Amount
plain_english_summary: The fixed dollar amount (e.g., $25 or $50) your plan requires for this type of visit or service.
patient_action_tip: Make sure you were not already charged this copay at check-in.

title: Charge exceeds fee schedule / maximum allowable amount
official_definition: Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.
plain_english_summary: The hospital billed more than the maximum amount permitted by their contract with your insurer. The hospital must write off this difference.
patient_action_tip: DO NOT PAY THIS AMOUNT. In-network healthcare providers are legally forbidden from balance billing you for this write-off.

title: Non-covered charge(s)
official_definition: Non-covered charge(s). At least one Remark Code must be provided.
plain_english_summary: Your health plan denied coverage because this procedure, drug, or supply is excluded from your policy benefits.
patient_action_tip: Ask your doctor's office to request a peer-to-peer review or submit an appeal showing medical necessity.

title: The benefit for this service is included in the payment for another service
official_definition: The benefit for this service is included in the payment/allowance for another service/procedure that has already been adjudicated.
plain_english_summary: This is unbundling or an inclusive service. The insurer considers this step part of the primary procedure and won't pay separately.
patient_action_tip: The provider cannot pass this fee to you if they are in-network. Verify that the provider wrote it off.

title: Precertification/authorization/notification absent
plain_english_summary: Prior authorization was required from your insurer before this service was performed, but none was obtained.
patient_action_tip: If the doctor was in-network, obtaining prior auth is usually the provider's contractual responsibility, not yours. Dispute this with billing.

title: Assessment of injury/illness is pending investigation of third party liability
official_definition: Sequestration - reduction in federal payment amount, or third party liability investigation.
plain_english_summary: The insurance company paused payment to see if another insurer (auto insurance, worker's comp) is responsible.
patient_action_tip: Call your insurer immediately to complete their simple accident/injury questionnaire so they can release payment.
